description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called SettingsFragment, which displays a settings menu with sections for general settings and others, including options like profile, favorites, app language, shortcuts, about, subscribe to beta, and logout. It also includes logic for language selection and logout confirmation dialog.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a settings screen with various user options such as profile, favorites, language, shortcuts, about, subscribe, and logout.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Helper method to construct individual settings list items with icon, title, optional subtitle, trailing widget, optional title color, and tap handler.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for logout; upon confirmation, clears preferences and navigates to the OTP validation screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree of the SettingsFragment, including language selection logic and list view layout.
